title: Chain context (chain-context/1)
description: The computed analytics for one underlying's option chain - PCR, ATM PCR, OI walls (resistance/support), headroom to each wall, ATM straddle premium and its implied expected range, and a directional bias verdict. Published by algo_scalper_api (analytics authority, plan component M1 / infrastructure roadmap G1) to Redis key `dhan:chain:context:{underlying}` after every ChainWatchService refresh (~1 s), TTL 15 s. options-trading-agent consumes it read-only for its headroom/confluence gates and MUST fall back to its own local computation when the snapshot is missing or stale - share data, not decisions: the verdict is advisory input, each consumer applies its own policy. Computed over the chain watch window (ATM +/-5 strikes), which is also what the agent's own analysis uses, so the two never disagree by window size.

expiry.description: Nearest expiry of the watched chain, ISO date.

spot.description: Underlying LTP the analytics were computed against.

computed_at_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds. Consumers apply their own freshness limit (agent default: 10 s).

source.description: Which system computed this context, e.g. 'algo_scalper_api'.

window_strikes.description: How many strikes around ATM the analytics window covered (ChainWatchService uses 5).

pcr.description: Put OI / Call OI over the window. 1.0 when both sides are zero.

atm_pcr.description: Put OI / Call OI within 3 strike-steps of ATM.

strike.description: Strike carrying the maximum call OI in the window (the resistance wall).

oi.description: Open interest at that strike, in contracts.

distance.description: strike - spot, in index points. Negative means the wall is below spot.

strike.description: Strike carrying the maximum put OI in the window (the support wall).

oi.description: Open interest at that strike, in contracts.

distance.description: spot - strike, in index points. Negative means the wall is above spot.

headroom_ce.description: Points from spot up to the call resistance wall (call_resistance.distance). The BULLISH entry gate rejects a trade when this is positive but below the configured minimum.

headroom_pe.description: Points from spot down to the put support wall (put_support.distance). The BEARISH entry gate rejects a trade when this is positive but below the configured minimum.

straddle_premium.description: ATM call mid + ATM put mid. 0 when the ATM row has no prices.

sentiment_score.description: Composite sentiment score: PCR terms (+/-25), ATM PCR (+/-20), wall distances (+/-25), call/put volume imbalance (+/-15), clamped to [-100, 100].

bias.description: score >= 20 -> BULLISH; score <= -20 -> BEARISH; else NEUTRAL.

verdict.description: One-line human-readable summary, e.g. 'BULLISH (score +40, PCR 1.31, ATM PCR 1.18)'.
